message.content: {"action":"switch_architecture","reason":"Current best-quality evaluated point is LUT linear phase_bits=16 (SQNR 82.1 dB, area 1584.6 um^2), while CORDIC is much larger for lower SQNR. However, the last several actions decreased precision and changed interpolation, landing near poor LUT configurations; switching architecture has 2 legal unvisited neighbors and can explore the CORDIC branch without further degrading numerical quality. This balances mapped area and SQNR by testing a structurally different implementation rather than continuing to reduce precision."}
